title: Elon Musk Has ‘Blood on His Hands’: Author Sounds the Alarm on DOGE’s Destruction
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
On Jan. 20, 2025, Donald Trump signed an executive order establishing the
Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) in a move that sent shockwaves
through the civil service and permanently altered the U.S.'s world standing.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

As Elon Musk and his band of twentysomethings took over government operations,
they unleashed widespread chaos that not just upended Americans' livelihoods
but delivered death sentences for millions worldwide who relied on U.S.
assistance.

Author **Michael Lewis** , whose new book on DOGE is titled _[Blockers: Rebels
in the Deep State](https://bookshop.org/p/books/blockers-michael-
lewis/dd148042c103aee0?ean=9781324131656)_ , tells **Mehdi** that Elon Musk
and his DOGE minions have **" blood on their hands"** - especially as an
[estimated](https://ph.ucla.edu/news-events/news/research-finds-
more-14-million-preventable-deaths-2030-if-usaid-defunding) 14 million people
are expected to die as result of USAID cuts.

And with a new Democratic majority in Congress come January, Lewis calls for
thorough investigations into DOGE: **" This is something Congress could do in
addition to following the money: follow the death."**

But what about cuts to the Department of Health and Human Services? Or DOGE's
access to IRS data?
